Class DatabaseManager

java.lang.Object
model.DatabaseManager
public class DatabaseManager extends Object
Manages all data persistence operations including saving and loading transactions and budget cycles to/from text files and saves it all. Implements Singleton pattern as mentioned in the SDS to ensure single database connection.

  • Method Details

    • getInstance

      public static DatabaseManager getInstance()
      Returns the single instance of DatabaseManager. Creates the instance if it doesn't exist yet. SINGLETON PATTERN: Ensures only one instance of DatabaseManager exists throughout the application.
      Returns:
      the only DatabaseManager instance

    • saveTransaction

      public void saveTransaction(Transaction t)
      Saves a transaction to memory and persists to file. If a transaction with the same ID exists, it updates it.
      Parameters:
      t - the Transaction object to save

    • loadTransactions

      public ArrayList<Transaction> loadTransactions()
      Loads all transactions from memory. Data is loaded from data.txt when the class is first instantiated.
      Returns:
      ArrayList of all Transaction objects

    • deleteTransaction

      public void deleteTransaction(int id)
      Deletes a transaction by its ID from memory and file.
      Parameters:
      id - the ID of the transaction to delete

    • saveCycle

      public void saveCycle(double budget, String start, String end, double remaining)
      Saves the budget cycle information to cycle.txt file. Used for tracking total budget, dates, and remaining balance.
      Parameters:
      budget - total budget amount for the cycle
      start - start date of the budget cycle
      end - end date of the budget cycle
      remaining - remaining balance in the cycle

    • clearAll

      public void clearAll()
      Clears all transactions from memory and file. Resets the entire transaction history.
